title: rust-toolchain.toml pins an exact Rust version so lint changes arrive deliberately
outcome: rust-toolchain.toml pins an exact Rust version so lint changes arrive deliberately
acceptance: rust-toolchain.toml names an exact Rust version instead of the floating stable channel, so a machine updating Rust cannot change gate results silently; moving to a newer version is its own reviewed changeset with its lint fixes

The pinned toolchain is installed on every machine that runs Engram's gates before the pin lands, with Greg's explicit word for each toolchain install, and no agent session auto-installs it unannounced
